Pantry Pal

Track what is in your pantry.

Inspiration

Our dorm kitchen kept throwing away food that expired at the back of the shelf. We built a barcode scanner app that remembers what you bought and suggests recipes before ingredients go bad, using a sensor-free approach that only needs a phone camera and a shared household list.

How we built it

React Native front end, a Flask service backed by SQLite, and a public product database for barcode lookups. Each household gets a shared list synced through the service.
